title: Social attention to one-hour realized variance
claim: Causal social-attention features improve next-hour realized-variance forecasts over the strongest market-only model across the ten-asset panel.
mechanism: Attention intensity proxies information arrival and heterogeneous reaction, increasing near-term price variation without determining direction.
target: Next one-hour realized variance from one-minute Binance returns

evidence.summary: Blind July QLIKE-loss improvement was 0.027668; all 10 assets improved and Holm-adjusted p=0.00001183.

nextAction: Implement pre-outcome prospective shadow publication and sealed outcome evaluation without modifying the frozen artifact.
